title: Getting started: Modifying the abstract interface for metadata

cues.en: So, apart from a little transitory use of the metadata for Documents and Chunks in the last lecture, or the last couple of lectures at least, when we're doing hybrid retrieval,
cues.zh: 除了上一堂或前幾堂進行混合檢索時，暫時使用 Documents 與 Chunks 的 metadata，

cues.en: we really haven't done anything with these two columns, with the JSONB columns in our Documents and Chunks table.
cues.zh: 其實還沒真正處理 documents 和 chunks 表裡這兩個 JSONB 欄位。

cues.en: So if I look at the Documents table, for example, I have two documents in there right now, and the metadata for each is empty.
cues.zh: 例如查看 documents，現在有兩份文件，各自的 metadata 都是空的。

cues.en: And if you look at the structure, that's a JSONB column, okay?
cues.zh: 看結構就知道，它是 JSONB 欄位，

cues.en: The metadata is a JSONB column.
cues.zh: metadata 就是 JSONB 欄位。

cues.en: And if I look at Chunks, I can look at the content as well, and you'll see that the metadata is empty for those as well.
cues.zh: 查看 chunks 的內容，也可以看到 metadata 都是空的，

cues.en: There's nothing in any of these.
cues.zh: 這些欄位完全沒有資料。

cues.en: But again, if you look at the structure, that is also a JSONB column.
cues.zh: 但同樣看結構，它也是 JSONB。

cues.en: Now what are these for?
cues.zh: 這些欄位有什麼用途？

cues.en: It's really useful to store information about Documents and about Chunks.
cues.zh: 儲存與文件、區塊相關的資訊非常有用。

cues.en: And why do we have one for Documents and one for Chunks?
cues.zh: 為什麼 documents 和 chunks 各有一個？

cues.en: Because we're going to be storing different kinds of information.
cues.zh: 因為要儲存的資訊種類不同。

cues.en: For example, in the Documents, I might store the author or the date and time that the document was ingested into the store.
cues.zh: 例如 documents 可以存作者，或文件匯入儲存區的日期時間，

cues.en: I might store the number of chunks, things like that.
cues.zh: 也可能存區塊數量等資訊。

cues.en: And later on, we're going to also care about what kind of content is stored in the database.
cues.zh: 稍後也要在意資料庫裡儲存的是什麼內容類型。

cues.en: Right now, we're just using text files, text and markdown.
cues.zh: 目前只使用文字檔，也就是純文字與 Markdown，

cues.en: But later on, we're also going to include images.
cues.zh: 但之後還會加入圖片。

cues.en: And we can't put an image directly in the vector database, but we can put information about the image in the vector database.
cues.zh: 不能直接把圖片放進向量資料庫，但可以存放圖片的資訊，

cues.en: What's it about? Describe it.
cues.zh: 例如圖片內容與描述、

cues.en: What kind of image is it?
cues.zh: 圖片是哪種類型、

cues.en: Where is the image stored?
cues.zh: 以及儲存位置，

cues.en: Things like that.
cues.zh: 諸如此類。

cues.en: And that's what we're going to turn our attention to this time around.
cues.zh: 這堂課就要專注這個部分，

cues.en: Not images, but actually populating and doing something with this metadata.
cues.zh: 不是圖片，而是填入 metadata 並實際使用它。

cues.en: So it's a pretty straightforward process.
cues.zh: 流程相當直接。

cues.en: Let's go back to our IDE.
cues.zh: 回到 IDE，

cues.en: And the first thing we're going to have to do is to extend the contract for our vector store types.
cues.zh: 首先需要擴充向量儲存區型別的契約。

cues.en: We only have Postgres, but later on, we're going to have Weaviate.
cues.zh: 目前只有 Postgres，但稍後也會有 Weaviate，

cues.en: And we want to make sure that both Postgres and Weaviate implement the same functionality.
cues.zh: 我們希望兩者都實作相同功能。

cues.en: So that means going back to base.py right here.
cues.zh: 所以要回到這裡的 base.py，

cues.en: And what we need to do is to come down to the upsert document abstract method here.
cues.zh: 找到 upsert_document 抽象方法，

cues.en: And we have to add an entry.
cues.zh: 新增一個參數，

cues.en: We're also going to be adding metadata.
cues.zh: 也就是 metadata。

cues.en: So metadata colon.
cues.zh: 寫 metadata，接冒號，

cues.en: And this is going to be a type dict with str and any.
cues.zh: 型別是 dict[str, Any]，

cues.en: But we also want to have none as an alternative set to none.
cues.zh: 同時允許 None，預設值設為 None。

cues.en: And that way, everything will continue to work.
cues.zh: 這樣原本的程式就能繼續運作。

cues.en: So we have metadata there.
cues.zh: metadata 加好了。

cues.en: And I see I missed a comma here.
cues.zh: 我發現這裡少了逗號，

cues.en: So put a comma there.
cues.zh: 補上逗號。

cues.en: So now we've added that to the abstract method upsert document.
cues.zh: 現在已在 upsert_document 抽象方法加入它。

cues.en: Now we also need to make a change here to the data class search head.
cues.zh: 也需要修改 SearchHit 資料類別，

cues.en: We have to add a value here because we have two kinds of metadata.
cues.zh: 增加一個欄位，因為有兩種中繼資料。

cues.en: We have metadata for chunks.
cues.zh: 有區塊的中繼資料，

cues.en: And that's what that entry on line 21 is for.
cues.zh: 這就是第 21 行那個欄位的用途。

cues.en: But of course, we also have to have one for documents.
cues.zh: 當然也需要文件的中繼資料，

cues.en: I'll just call that document underscore metadata.
cues.zh: 就叫做 document_metadata，

cues.en: And that will be, once again, a dict of str and any.
cues.zh: 同樣是 dict[str, Any]。

cues.en: And we'll make that equal to.
cues.zh: 將它的預設值設為，

cues.en: And we'll just use field.
cues.zh: 使用 field，

cues.en: Field, or straight out of the data classes, default underscore factory equals dict, OK?
cues.zh: 也就是 dataclasses 裡的 field，設定 default_factory=dict。

cues.en: Now I see I have field here.
cues.zh: 現在這裡使用了 field，

cues.en: But I guess I didn't import it.
cues.zh: 但我好像沒有匯入，

cues.en: So let's go back up to the top here.
cues.zh: 所以回到最上方，

cues.en: And after data classes, we need to import field, OK?
cues.zh: 從 dataclasses 多匯入 field。

cues.en: And that should be all the changes we have to make to base.py.
cues.zh: 這應該就是 base.py 所需的全部變更。

cues.en: Now, because we've made a change to the contract, that means that postgres.py, that implementation of this abstract interface, it no longer satisfies it.
cues.zh: 因為更改了契約，就代表 postgres.py 的抽象介面實作，現在不再滿足要求，

cues.en: So we'll have to go back and make some changes there.
cues.zh: 所以要回頭修改那裡。

cues.en: But they're pretty simple.
cues.zh: 不過變更很簡單，

cues.en: And we'll get started on that in the next lecture.
cues.zh: 下一堂就開始。
